# Briefing Preferences

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Daily brief:** 06:45, weekdays. Order: (1) overnight safety events / capacity status across
  the four hospitals, (2) today's meetings with prep, (3) commitments due or overdue,
  (4) anything needing a decision today.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Weekly preview:** Sunday 17:00 — the week ahead, top priorities, and at-risk items.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Weekly retro:** Friday 15:00 — what moved, what slipped, and the operational metrics
  (ED throughput, occupancy, agency hours) for the week.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Always surface:** overdue commitments and any project whose status changed since the last
  brief (e.g. Epic Phase 1 moving into stabilization).
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Keep confidential:** refer to Lantern by code name in every brief; never include Karen
  Osei's retirement intent.
